newsitem.title: UK: Cairn says study of Command delayed.
newsitem.headline: Cairn says study of Command delayed.

text.p: Cairn Energy Plc, an independent oil producer, said on Wednesday that a technical report it had commissioned to support its ongoing takeover of Australia's Command Petroleum Ltd was not going to be published today, as it had earlier announced, but would be delayed until next week.

"Due to the extensive time and effort required to produce such a technical report it is now anticipated that this will be finalised by December 11, enabling Cairn to post its circular to shareholders on December 12," the company said in a statement.
Cairn's A$1.10 per share cash bid for Command is due to close on December 12.
